claims.statement: run_dispatch_cycle is the single unit of work the dispatcher, queue watchdog, and CLI `dispatch` command trigger; it uses an exclusive process-level file lock so concurrent cycles do not overlap, while the background thread (_dispatcher_loop via start_background_dispatcher) drives it every DISPATCH_INTERVAL_SECONDS (30s).

The dispatcher claims ready tasks under each board's max_concurrent_running limit (default DEFAULT_MAX_CONCURRENT_WORKERS), global max_active_tasks and max_concurrent_llm_workers caps, and per-task timeout defaults of 1 hour running time and 15 minutes inactivity.

Every task executes in its own isolated Git worktree on a task/<task_id> branch. setup_worktree resolves the board/repository and creates ~/.zerofactory/workspaces/<board>/worktrees/<task_id>/<repo_alias>; every `git worktree add` uses _WORKTREE_ADD_TIMEOUT and stale registrations are pruned before a retry, so workers do not touch main directly and the worktree survives worker crashes.
When a task is completed or manually abandoned, terminal cleanup removes its worktree and, when requested, deletes the remote task/<task_id> branch.

Merge conflicts are routed, not swallowed: local and GitHub PR conflict handlers increment conflict_retries and send a conflicted task back to zf-builder; when the retry budget is exceeded, the first exhaustion routes to zf-orchestrator for one autonomous diagnostic attempt (if orchestrator_recovery_count < 1), otherwise the task is parked in blocked for a human.

spawn_agent_worker launches the assigned specialist as a detached Hermes subprocess with stdin=DEVNULL and stderr merged into the worker log, pins HERMES_HOME to the profile home, and uses --cli chat -q <prompt>; --yolo --accept-hooks are added only when unattended approvals are enabled. It correlates the new session_id against the assigned profile's state.db. Reviewer prompts resolve the target branch by (board_slug, repo_alias), fall back to the board's first repository, and include the round header, task specification, and skip_untested_check flag.

Before commit/PR packaging, run_deterministic_precommit executes the worktree's .zerofactory/precommit.sh (format → build → test) with CI=1, a timeout, and captured output; it skips only when ZEROFACTORY_SKIP_PRECOMMIT is set or the script is absent.

_handle_precommit_failure increments metadata[precommit_retries] and stores the last error; within the configured retry budget (default 3), it routes the task back to zf-builder as todo and retains the failure output in task comments/metadata so the respawned worker receives the exact issue. After retries are exhausted, the first exhaustion routes to zf-orchestrator for one diagnostic recovery attempt; a later exhaustion parks the task in blocked for a human.
git_ops.py provides low-level Git plumbing: resolving and syncing the default branch, detecting unresolved conflict markers, and cleaning stale Git lock files before synchronization.

github_pr.py fetches PR review comments and formats them into task comments; ai_prefix(text, role) prepends a role-tagged [AI:<role>] marker (default zf-builder) to agent-authored GitHub text and is idempotent for any existing role-tagged [AI:<tag>] marker, so humans can distinguish agent output from human output.

The reaper shares _compute_stuck_state between reap_active_workers and check_stuck_tasks so their timeout/inactivity criteria stay aligned; reap_stuck_tasks also terminates processes on a manual reap and retries WAL-locked writes with capped backoff. A crashed or vanished running worker is retried up to DEFAULT_MAX_WORKER_RETRIES, then routed to one zf-orchestrator recovery attempt when eligible; a later exhaustion parks it in blocked for a human.

is_actionable_review_comment filters PR feedback to genuine reviewer or human critiques: approval/pass verdicts, builder-authored or automated notes, dedup/status updates, and empty bodies are excluded so only actionable feedback routes a task back to the builder.

The dispatcher increments review_round for each batch of actionable PR feedback, alongside legacy commit_review_count, without resetting the per-PR budget when the PR head changes. At ZEROFACTORY_MAX_REVIEW_ROUNDS (default 2), it parks the task at the human gate; quiet polls hold that park until new feedback arrives. The recover endpoint clears review_cap_reached, review_round, and commit_review_count.
When a task carries external_issue metadata, the PR body opened by the dispatcher appends 'Fixes #<n>' for GitHub issues or 'Resolves: <KEY>' for Jira issues so merging the PR links the source issue.

When builder work completes, the task stays running with awaiting_pr set and _package_and_open_pr owns deterministic packaging: precommit, anti-slop, commit, merge, push, PR creation, and reviewer routing. Packaging command failures have a three-attempt budget before the task is parked for a human; _finalize_terminal_done only cleans up and never commits, pushes, opens a PR, or routes back to review.

post_issue_pr_comment posts exactly one 'PR opened' status reply onto the source GitHub issue when a PR is opened: gated on external_issue.source=='github', a present issue id, and has_ai_request (baked in at import time), and idempotent via the '<!-- zf-task:<task_id> -->' HTML marker checked through gh issue view; any failure is logged and never propagates.

Task status and assignee transitions funnel through transition_task, which validates moves against VALID_TRANSITIONS and raises InvalidStateTransitionError for illegal edges; resolve_status_assignee in paths.py provides canonical assignee resolution for the target status.

The per-board improvement scanner runs inside the dispatcher process. Each cycle reaps completed/dead scanner processes without removing a live scanner or its PID record. When global LLM capacity, per-board active-task and Todo limits, scan_on_idle, duplicate-scanner, and cooldown gates permit, the cycle spawns a background zf-orchestrator scan; its prompt queues findings directly in todo for zf-builder. Lifecycle helpers are get_active_scanner_pids, kill_board_scanner, and reap_active_scanners.

After precommit passes, packaging runs the zero-token anti-slop gate with the resolved target branch, task spec, and skip_untested_check flag. It blocks leftover debuggers, placeholder comments, skipped tests, assertion-free new tests, untested production additions over 20 net lines, Do Not Touch file violations, and diffs over the default 800-line cap (overridable by ZEROFACTORY_MAX_DIFF_LINES); the diff-hygiene scorecard is pre-digested into the reviewer prompt.

A clean zf-reviewer exit that recorded no verdict via `block --reason ...` is not retried: the reaper parks the task in blocked with blocked_reason_type 'human-gate' and the reason 'Reviewer exited without recording a verdict; awaiting human review', clearing awaiting_pr so the task never re-enters the packaging phase.
